messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: error in removing x-axis ticks by grid.gremove
parts:
Hi,

try this:

ggplot(mtcars, aes(cyl, mpg)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~am)

g <- grid.gget(gPath("axis_h", "", "", "", "axis.ticks.segments"))

# or
# g <- llply(grid.gget("axis_h", grep = T), getGrob, "axis.ticks", grep = T)

l_ply(g, function(x)grid.remove(x$name))

--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology,
The University of  Tokyo, Japan.

parts:
Hi Kohske,

Thanks again for the reply previously.

Now I tried to print the object to a pdf file by following command:


pdf(file=paste(path,"plot.pdf"),height=4,width=7)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(cyl, mpg)) + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~am)

g <- grid.gget(gPath("axis_h", "", "", "", "axis.ticks.segments"))

l_ply(g, function(x)grid.remove(x$name))

dev.off()


Instead of giving a sinlge plot, it gives multiple plots ( plot before
and after removing ticks) on multiple pages.
Is there any way I can suppress the preceding plots and only print the
plot with ticks removed?

Thank you.

Max
